verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs confirm that project templates exist and say what they carry over: views, custom fields, draft issues, workflows (except auto-add) and insights. That is a real starting-point capability. The evidence does not show vendor-supplied pre-built templates or how a new project is created from one. Missing for 10: evidence of GitHub-provided pre-built templates, documentation of the create-from-template flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Project templates include the views, custom fields, draft issues and associated fields, configured workflows (except any auto-add workflows), and insights.
